children: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates:

The markets return to trading after the weekend break and with the results season coming to an end, the focus will shift back to global cues, and of course, the supply of paper that has already begun during the course of last week with block deals in Meesho, and the launches of large QIPs in companies like Bajaj Finance.

For the Nifty, 25,400 continues to be a resistance point, as the index struggled to cross that level all through last week, with profit booking setting in on Friday. In case that continues today, the bulls would want to hold on to the 25,000 mark on the downside, with the next support emerging at 24,900 - 24,850 zones.

The Nifty Bank led the profit booking on Friday on expected lines, but managed to hold on to the 61,000 mark. The 60,800 - 60,900 zone could well be a support base for the index, while Friday's high of 61,300 is something the bulls would want to cross and sustain above, for making a move back towards record high levels.

The final few result reactions take place today from Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Kaynes Tech, Zaggle Prepaid, Eicher Motors, Zetwerk, Jubilant Pharmova and others. The biggest triggers of the week though, come from the US, with Nvidia's results, and the Anthropic IPO.

title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: GIFT Nifty gives up some gains, trades 50 pts higher
